notes.key_messages:
In order that candidates receive credit where possible for incorrect answers, they should remember to show
full working and reasoning. Incorrect answers without working cannot be given any credit, whereas partial
credit can be awarded if a correct method is shown. Where candidates are asked to ‘show’ or ‘prove’ a
result, marks will be lost if any essential steps in the argument are omitted.
notes.general_comments:
There was a wide spread of marks for this paper. The majority were well prepared and showed considerable
skill in their working. However, there were also some weaker candidates who were less well prepared.
Questions 1, 3 and 7 were particularly well done. Most candidates found Questions 2(ii), 5 and 8(iii) to be
more difficult.
Presentation was generally excellent and there seemed no sign that a lack of time hindered candidates.
